svg.title: iTunes Miniplayer color and font dictionary
svg.desc: Three-column hue-grouped source swatches, PNG/XML reference counts, font sizes, one palette catalog with inline NullPlayer usage, and compact font summaries. An 800px-wide layout; counts are source references, not pixels.

svg.text: Fonts: Lucida Grande (default), DejaVu Sans Regular/Bold (bundled), Tahoma (altfont). Native
content may choose its own font.
NP: bars / borders / dividers blend 10 / 28 / 18% toward text; dim text 40% toward content;
EQ Studio: wells darken content 40%, then slots another 40%. Meter colors are host-owned.
Theme, contrast guards and user overrides can change the result.
svg.metadata: {"eq_background": "EQ Studio does not use wasabi.window.background.", "host_commit": "ea2545a8332a4fa669d0d237cd0decd079f7e0b9", "raster": "Gradients, antialiasing, noise, state shading, chrome tint and the 8% LCD ink blend create uncounted derived pixels.", "regenerate": "python3 \"source code/build_dictionary.py\"", "screenshots": "Artist-supplied PNGs are not generated or counted as font/color source references; the logo glyph uses a 32px input.", "sources": ["https://github.com/ad-repo/nullplayer/blob/ea2545a8332a4fa669d0d237cd0decd079f7e0b9/Sources/NullPlayer/WinampModern/WasabiPalette.swift", "https://github.com/ad-repo/nullplayer/blob/ea2545a8332a4fa669d0d237cd0decd079f7e0b9/Sources/NullPlayer/WinampModern/WinampModernSurfaceStyle.swift", "https://github.com/ad-repo/nullplayer/blob/ea2545a8332a4fa669d0d237cd0decd079f7e0b9/Sources/NullPlayer/App/Skinning/SkinnedSurfaceStyle.swift", "https://github.com/ad-repo/nullplayer/blob/ea2545a8332a4fa669d0d237cd0decd079f7e0b9/Sources/NullPlayer/Windows/EqualizerStudio/EqualizerStudioView.swift", "https://github.com/ad-repo/nullplayer/blob/ea2545a8332a4fa669d0d237cd0decd079f7e0b9/Sources/NullPlayer/Windows/EqualizerStudio/StudioFaceplate.swift"], "tree_fallback": "The host requests studio.tree.*; our wasabi.tree.* roles fall back to list/selection colors."}
